description.value: Pizza Factory is a locally focused pizza restaurant on Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge, offering an extensive menu of specialty and create-your-own pizzas alongside pasta, wings, and salads. The menu covers a wide range of dietary preferences, including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options. Online ordering with pickup makes it a straightforward refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor.

address.value: 20769 Lougheed Hwy., Maple Ridge, BC V2X2R2
